intro.text: Governor Replar Innate's bodyguard: a thick-necked man who growls and snaps at people, but whom Wax still rates as solid, loyal and dependable.
The head of Governor Replar Innate's security: a thick-necked man who growls and snaps at people, but whom Wax still rates as solid, loyal and dependable.

items.text: At Lady ZoBell's party Drim kept close to Governor Innate and grumbled at Wax that the door guards had let him in armed. Wax replied that he could turn any metal in the room into a weapon anyway, so the party was safer with him carrying guns.

When the governor left the party, Drim sent three unmarked carriages away, two of them decoys, a precaution that impressed Wax. Drim scoffed at Wax's warning about kandra, but Innate believed it and made Wax head of his security in Drim's place, giving them both passcodes to prove who they were.
Drim was killed inside a saferoom in the governor's mansion.

personality.text: He growls and snaps at people. He and Wax dislike each other, yet Wax considers him solid, loyal and dependable.
